# Fuel App (فيول آب)

> Fuel App (فيول آب) is a Saudi fuel supply and transport brand of Maisan Company (شركة ميسان), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It supplies diesel and gasoline, transports resources from Aramco sites, and gives business customers a platform to order and track fuel deliveries and receive paperless e-invoices. It serves companies, factories, fuel stations, projects and fleets in the Central, Eastern, Western and Northern regions of the Kingdom.

Language: the site is Arabic-first (https://fuelapp.sa/) with a full English version (https://fuelapp.sa/en/).

## Contact

- Email: Info@Fuelapp.sa

- Quote requests: https://fuelapp.sa/en/contact/ (the form opens WhatsApp with a ready-made message to 920009088)

## Services
- Diesel supply: for companies, factories and fuel stations, in precise quantities and on committed schedules.
- Gasoline supply: for fuel stations and the daily requirements of companies.
- Regular supply contracts: an ongoing supply relationship with follow-up on orders and invoices.
- Resource transport from Aramco: crude, bitumen, MC1 and MC2 from Aramco sites to work sites.
- Bulk fuel transport: within the Kingdom.
- Diesel and industrial oils: for energy, construction and industrial operations.
- Special logistics requests: solutions designed around specific requirements.

## Sectors served
Construction & projects, factories, fuel stations, transport & logistics, utilities & facilities, commercial fleets.

## Coverage (hub city of each region)
- Central Region (hub: Riyadh): Riyadh, Al-Kharj, Al Majmaah, Al-Qassim (Buraidah) and industrial cities
- Eastern Region (hub: Dammam): Dammam, Al Khobar, Jubail, Al-Ahsa and industrial cities
- Western Region (hub: Jeddah): Jeddah, Makkah, Taif, Rabigh, Madinah, Yanbu
- Northern Region (hub: Hail): Hail, Tabuk, Al-Jouf (Sakaka), Northern Borders (Arar)
